The '''1981–82 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] on 16 May 1982, coming down to a win by Juventus and a draw by [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]]. Going into the final week, both teams were tied at 44 points. Juventus defeated Catanzaro 1:0 while Fiorentina and Cagliari played to a 0:0 draw.

==Teams==
[[A.C. Milan|Milan]], [[A.C. Cesena|Cesena]] and [[Genoa C.F.C.|Genoa]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
